SPRINTO_API_KEY.description: Sprinto API key. Minted at Sprinto admin -> API Access. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

SPRINTO_API_URL.description: Sprinto API base URL. Default 'https://api.sprinto.com'. Override only for EU / dedicated tenants.

SPRINTO_MODE.description: Comma-separated list of what to import. Default 'checks'. Valid: checks (failing checks -> vulns), assets (monitored assets -> hosts), personnel (workforce inventory -> synthetic hosts).

SPRINTO_FRAMEWORK.description: Restrict checks to a Sprinto framework key (e.g. 'soc2', 'iso27001', 'hipaa', 'gdpr'). Omit for all frameworks.

SPRINTO_MAX_PAGES.description: Hard cap on pages fetched per mode. Default 50 (= 5k rows at the default page size).

SPRINTO_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Client-side severity floor for failing checks. Valid: info | low | medium | high | critical. Default 'medium'.

name: sprinto
title: Sprinto
description: Sprinto continuous-compliance import. Bearer API key, walks the public REST API (default https://api.sprinto.com/v1/): failing checks become Faraday vulnerabilities tagged '[GRC]' on the affected assets (or a synthetic 'grc:sprinto:global' host if the check isn't scoped to one), monitored assets become Faraday hosts tagged 'grc:sprinto:asset-inventory', and personnel become synthetic workforce hosts. Set SPRINTO_FRAMEWORK=soc2|iso27001|hipaa|gdpr to scope checks. Severity is normalised from Sprinto's enum into Faraday's info/low/medium/high/critical scheme; SPRINTO_MIN_SEVERITY drops rows below the floor. External IDs are stable so re-runs are idempotent. Pagination via offset/limit; backs off 30s on HTTP 429.
